description: Kanban board TUI with column management and card CRUD

tasks.description: In the IN PROGRESS column, find card FLOW-4 and open it to view its full content.
Switch to the TO DO column, create a new card with the first line title '# {{file_content}}'.
In the TO DO column, find FLOW-1 and change the title from Add counts to column headers to {{file_content}}, keeping the leading '#' symbol.
In the TO DO column, find FLOW-2 and append a new line {{file_content}} at the end of the content area.
